product.name: ExpandCart E-commerce Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for creating and managing online stores with multi-language, multi-currency support, and integration with payment gateways and shipping providers.

product.name: ExpandCart Sales Channels Integration
product.description: Integration tools that connect online stores with social media platforms, marketplaces, and sales channels like Facebook, Instagram, Amazon, and Google Shopping.

product.name: ExpandCart Marketing Tools
product.description: A suite of marketing applications including SEO optimization, email and SMS campaigns, discount coupons, abandoned cart recovery, and affiliate marketing.

product.name: ExpandCart Dropshipping Support
product.description: Functionality and integrations that enable merchants to operate dropshipping businesses without holding inventory or managing shipping.

product.name: ExpandCart Mobile Application Service
product.description: Mobile app development service that provides merchants with branded mobile applications linked to their online stores.

product.description: Professional assistance service for building, designing, and launching online stores, including marketing support and technical help.
